Subject: Post-call: SOC 2 / Audit logs / Retention - Next steps

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we have aligned next steps. Happy to hop on a quick follow-up if helpful.

Summary of pain points you shared:
- Need to verify SOC 2 compliance posture and access to audit/log evidence for vendor due diligence.
- Questions on retention policies for request/response logs and KV cache data.
- Requirement to understand how we handle sensitive PII in traces and whether you can disable storing prompts for certain routes.
- Pen test evidence and third-party attestations (if available) for security review.

Goals you mentioned:
1) Confirm Redwood meets SOC 2 readiness for vendor onboarding by mid-May.
2) Validate ability to support 7-year retention/archival requests (or map to acceptable alternatives).
3) Get artifacts our security team can review: SOC 2 report, pen test summary, DPA, data retention docs, and audit-log sampling.

Notes from the call:
- You run inference on PHI-like workload but will keep production isolation; interested in Private (VPC) deployment for regulated data.
- Main KPI is proof-of-control and clear traceability for access to stored logs.

Action items / next steps:
1) I will send our SOC 2 overview and the standard evidence we can share (redwood-soc2-overview.pdf). — Marissa (by EOD today).
2) Jordan to share Acme’s vendor questionnaire and any specific legal data points (you mentioned a spreadsheet). — Jordan (ASAP).
3) Rishi can scope pen-test evidence and confirm what we can redact before sharing. — Rishi (by 2027-04-05).
4) Neha will coordinate a short technical follow-up call to walk through audit-log formats and retention options. — Neha (by next week).

If I missed anything critical, call it out and I’ll update.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear recap.

I've attached our standard vendor security questionnaire (acme-soc2-questionnaire.xlsx). A few clarifications from our security and legal teams based on today:
- Retention: we typically request a 7-year retention for audit packets; please confirm if Redwood can provide an export and/or archival plan that meets this.
- Audit logs: can you provide a sample of the log schema (timestamps, actor ids, request/response hashes) and an example export format (CSV/JSON)?
- Pen test evidence: we can accept a redacted executive summary of the latest external pentest plus confirmation of remediation dates.
- DPA: please send a copy of your DPA with the data processing terms and subprocessors listed.

Priya from Legal is on copy for contracting questions — Priya, any additional items to flag?

Happy to set a 30-min follow-up next week to review your artifacts live. Our window is Tue/Wed 10–12 ET.

Jordan
Director, Vendor Risk — Acme Health
jordan.mills@acmehealth.com

Jordan / Priya —

Thanks for the questionnaire. Quick updates and what we'll deliver this week: 

Deliverables (by 2027-04-05):
- SOC 2 overview and redactable report excerpts (redwood-soc2-overview.pdf) — attached in initial email; full report can be shared under NDA/secure link.
- Pen-test executive summary and remediation matrix (Rishi to confirm exact file).
- Example audit-log export (JSON + CSV schema) and a short doc on our retention controls and options (auto-archival vs export).
- Draft DPA with subprocessors list for your legal review (we'll provide as a PDF and a DocuSign link if you want an executed copy).

Operational constraints we discussed:
- For privacy, Redwood can allow route-level opt-out of logging; for Private deployments we support customer-managed KMS and additional isolation.
- Long-term archival: we can export logs for ingestion to Acme's long-term storage; for some on-host caches we recommend a 30/90-day hot-cache window plus archival snapshoting to match your retention SLA.

Proposed next meeting:
- 30 minutes: Technical artifacts review + Q&A
- Options: Tue Apr 6 10:30 ET or Wed Apr 7 11:00 ET — please confirm what works and we'll send a calendar invite.

Assigning internal owners: Neha will lead the technical walkthrough; Rishi will own pen-test evidence and redaction; I will coordinate the DPA and commercial touches.

Let me know if you need anything sooner.
